name: Back Whisk
notes: Standard name (International Style waltz): the Whisk danced backward. Added for the library at the owner's request; not danced in class. The lead goes back on the left, back and side on the right, then crosses the left behind the right into promenade. The opening is split evenly between the partners, as in the owner's Whisk, though standard technique has the follow make most of it. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
